dedupe_keys.name: high resolution multi modal accessibility metrics for switzerland

description: This dataset gives per-cell accessibility metrics for Switzerland at about 100 m resolution on the H3 grid (resolution 10). Accessibility is computed in three cost domains, gross door-to-door travel time, utility from a fitted mode-choice model and straight-line distance, and for three metric families, cumulative opportunities, nearest-k and exponential gravity. Time-based results cover walking (average and reduced mobility), regular bicycles, 25 and 45 km/h e-bikes, car at night, daytime and peak hours, and public transport based on Swiss NPVM zone-to-zone times with a per-cell access correction. The CSV files are indexed by H3 cell id, with a GeoPackage of cells in the Swiss LV95 system. It was produced by Marco Miotti, Arnor Bragi Elvarsson and Stefanie Hellweg at ETH Zürich with the Aperta tool. Coverage is Switzerland. Access: free download from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 (version 0.1.0, July 2026). Caveats: this is an early version, utility values are population aggregates, and the authors plan more precise transit accessibility later. It supports accessibility and equity analysis, mode shift and disruption impact studies, and complements the Aperta tool and the Swiss national passenger transport model catalogued here.
